info.title: Learning Matters API
info.description: Production-grade REST API backend for Learning Matters with strict TypeScript, Express 5, JWT authentication with rotating refresh tokens, RBAC, and structured observability.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your short-lived access JWT (e.g. Bearer <token>)

get.description: Verifies database pool and dependent systems before accepting traffic.

200.description: Service is ready to handle traffic

503.description: Service or dependent system is not ready

post.description: Creates a new user with argon2 password hashing and returns access + refresh tokens. Rate limited.

409.description: User with this email already exists

post.description: Constant-time verification against argon2 hashes to prevent user enumeration. Rate limited.

401.description: Invalid email or password (generic to avoid enumeration)

post.description: Validates raw refresh token against SHA-256 hash, revokes it, and issues a new pair. If a revoked token is reused, all tokens in the family are immediately revoked.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Revokes the specified refresh token session.

post.summary: Revoke all sessions for current user
post.description: Revokes all active refresh tokens belonging to the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the full profile of the authenticated user based on the access token.
